final: WITH pairs AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS tradekind, tr.transreg AS transreg, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord tr ON a.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind, tr.transreg), tot AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM pairs) SELECT p.tradekind, AVG(p.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(p.cnt * 1.0 / tot.total) AS avg_share FROM pairs p, tot GROUP BY p.tradekind
